title_id: Mecosin Goes to Campus bersama UMN
title_en: Mecosin Goes to Campus with UMN
excerpts: The collaboration that will be established between PT Mecosin Indonesia and UMN is outlined in the Mecosin Goes to Campus program, which will be followed by internship programs, training and community service.

Meanwhile, UMN's External Student Affairs Manager, Elfira Fitri Wahyono, said that collaboration with industry is an obligation for the UMN community. Moreover, industrial progress is currently very rapid. Adaptation and collaboration are important to balance this.

PT Mecosin Indonesia is collaborating with the Faculty of Pharmacy, Pancasila University to provide students with direct experience of working in the pharmaceutical industry and share knowledge in the pharmaceutical field.
Followed by a visit to the PT Mecosin Indonesia factory location in the Bogor area, West Java, to find out about the production process from raw materials to packaging and ready for distribution.

On May 6, 2020, PT Mecosin Indonesia visited the office of the Indonesian Medical Association (PB IDI) to convey empathy and sympathy for the pandemic situation in Indonesia. The presence of the Mecosin team at the office located in Central Jakarta was to deliver assistance in the form of LASERIN herbal cough medicine to the Indonesian General Practitioners Association (PDUI).
